title: Concrete localization complex as exact open restriction
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $P$ any cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let $U\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be open [def-pc-scheme], and $f\in A$ with $D(f)\subseteq U$. Choose independent derived categories on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, $U$, and $\operatorname{Spec}(A_f)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. There exists an open immersion $j:\operatorname{Spec}(A_f)\to U$ and an additive exact module-sheaf functor $R$, naturally isomorphic to restriction along $j$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], such that $R_D(E_U)\cong Q(\widetilde{P_f})$. Here $E_U$ is exact canonical restriction to $U$ of $Q(\widetilde P)$; $P_f$ is the concrete termwise Mathlib localizedModuleFunctor at powers of $f$, including its Shrink equivalences. No Tor-amplitude, boundedness, freeness or quasi-compactness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Affine pullback comparison (2), specialized to exact principal localization

proof.text: Identify the localization spectrum with D(f), and factor its open immersion through U. Ordinary restriction along this map is additive and exact; the open-immersion restriction comparisons identify its composite with restriction from Spec(A) to Spec(A_f).

Use the natural tilde pullback comparison for A to A_f and identify ordinary scalar extension with module localization by its universal property and the canonical Shrink equivalences. The natural comparison lifts to complexes and respects differentials. Localization is exact, so termwise localization computes derived localization. The exact functor localization factorizations give the displayed derived isomorphism.

theorem principalLocalization_restriction_model
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wU}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : A) (hf : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wF}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace))] :
    ∃ j : Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)) ⟶ U.toScheme,
      ∃ hj : IsOpenImmersion j,
        letI := hj
        ∃ R : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u}
              (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace),
          Nonempty (R ≅ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j) ∧
          ∃ hAdd : R.Additive, ∃ hLim : PreservesFiniteLimits R,
            ∃ hCol : PreservesFiniteColimits R,
              letI := hAdd
              letI := hLim
              letI := hCol
              Nonempty ((R.mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((@Functor.mapDerivedCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
                (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
              Equivalence.functor
                (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
                  ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))
                (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
                (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U))
            (Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _)
            (comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _) (comp_preservesFiniteColimits _ _)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
                (tilde.functor (.of A)) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)))) ≅
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f))
              (SheafOfModules.{u}
                (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
              (tilde.functor (.of (Localization.Away f))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
              (((ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor (Submonoid.powers f)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P))))
